summary.zh-TW: 收播後可保存場次、連結回放並匯出時間點。這版也加入播放清單資料夾、兩款直書歌詞、歌詞校訂與字幕匯出，以及可分開設定的介面與畫面輸出語言。
summary.en-US: Save your session, link the replay, and export timestamps after a stream. This update also adds playlist folders, two vertical lyrics styles, lyric correction with subtitle export, and separate language settings for the app and Output.
